priorityList: Use Reaver's Glaive to apply Reaver's Mark and trigger Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry buffs whenever they are not active.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown or the Demonic window has just ended, ensuring Blade Dance is also on cooldown.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to enter Metamorphosis, ideally when Blade Dance/Death Sweep is on cooldown.
During Metamorphosis, use Essence Break if you have enough Fury and Death Sweep is available or nearly ready.
Prioritize Death Sweep or Annihilation during the Essence Break window.
Prioritize Death Sweep (or Annihilation if talented) whenever the Demonsurge buff is active during Metamorphosis.
Use Annihilation (in Meta) or Chaos Strike (outside Meta) while the Aldrachi Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry buffs are active.
Cast Death Sweep (in Meta) or Blade Dance (outside Meta) on cooldown.
Use The Hunt on cooldown, ideally when Essence Break is down and you are not currently holding Reaver's Glaive buffs.
Use Vengeful Retreat and Fel Rush to maintain Initiative or Inertia buffs if talented, especially before Eye Beam or Essence Break.
Cast Immolation Aura on cooldown for Fury generation and to maintain Ragefire (if talented).
Use Felblade to generate Fury when below 40 or to close the gap to your target.
Cast Annihilation or Chaos Strike as your primary Fury spender when above 75 Fury or to avoid capping.
Use Throw Glaive as a filler if talented into Soulscar or if you are out of range and have no other available actions.
Use Arcane Torrent if you are low on Fury (below 35) and all other generators are on cooldown.
